title: What Is the Hardest Sport in the World?
content:
When people ask, "What is the hardest sport in the world," they usually focus on injuries or skill. But the answer depends on how you define "hard." A
re we talking about physical contact, mental toughness, or the extreme coordination required to execute under pressure? The hardest sports test every part of the human body and mind.
